global: The council votes on Tuesday, and I'd hate for anyone to miss the chance to explain why {fief} is now in better hands.
Ha! {enemy_faction} left their gates unguarded and we simply walked in. Strategy is a wonderful thing, isn't it?
Lords of Ormerath, take note: {my_faction} holds {fief} now, and we intend to govern it far better than its last keepers.
Oh, do forgive the tears in {enemy_faction}'s banners. I'm sure they'll find another flag to wave soon enough.
Some lords rule by sword, others by patience. I'd like to think {my_faction} managed both at {fief}.
The garrison at {fief} surrendered after a single afternoon. I'm told their morale was more fragile than their walls.
Let it be recorded that {my_faction} took {fief} through proper channels. The council will be pleased with the paperwork.
Pity about {enemy_faction}. Surely someone should have told them that castles need more than good intentions to hold.
